title: pterocephalus pterocephala
intro: Pterocephalus pterocephala, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species within the family Caprifoliaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote respiratory health, ease inflammation, and support the immune system. The health benefits of Pterocephalus pterocephala are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
